options.name: Reuse existing lifecycle and implement explicit same-tick arrival-before-retarget ordering
options.established_principle: GPPO paper updates task lists on completion; SimPy documents deterministic sequential processing of same-time events. Neither source prescribes this project's mesh-anchor retarget order.
options.exact_local_evidence: Current scheduler lines928-932 refreshes anchors before testing arrival; augmentation lines1043-1045 compares physical pose with the now-mutated anchor. The parent is independently validating the causal swap.
options.compatibility: Existing observation-only positions, helper budgets, reservations, candidate guards and Safety preemption remain reusable. Snapshot/consume arrival before mutating the target that defines arrival is a minimal local design inference.
options.do_not_redo: Do not install SimPy, replace the scheduler, add a new planner, or claim the call-order repair is a reproduction of the GPPO paper.
options.acceptance: Parent's controlled paired physical H300 validation remains necessary; this audit adds no rollout evidence.

options.compatibility: Use the official functions as an oracle for loss/mask/return audits. Existing graph/action layouts need adapters, so wholesale porting is unnecessary. Preserve identical behavior/update model modes and saved legal-action masks.
options.objective: Paper Eq15-17 minimizes global maximum completion time using M_previous-M_current. Physical H300 joint completion is aligned in intent, but -(completion-t)/300 suffix returns are a local adaptation, not the literal paper reward. GAE alone does not solve causal credit assignment.
options.cautions: gamma<1 per irregular assignment event weights event count rather than elapsed physical time; copying .99/.95 changes the objective. H300 can be an intentional finite-horizon penalty, so do not blindly treat every horizon as a bootstrappable time-limit truncation.
options.do_not_redo: Do not rebuild GAE/collation/PPO or retrain native MARVEL just to repair a lifecycle ordering bug.

options.name: CBBA-PR and CBBA-with-Relays as optional design references only
options.reusable_principle: CBBA-PR limits the allocation subset reopened on a new task; its convergence result requires resetting the last/lowest bid items in bundle-build order. CBBA-with-Relays creates relay tasks from predicted topology using underutilized agents.
options.compatibility: Useful precedent for bounded local repair and persistent useful assignments. Official ACL page links baseline time-window MATLAB code; it does NOT establish that this zip includes CBBA-PR or relay extensions.
options.not_drop_in: Current implementation is not decentralized CBBA, has no bid bundles, and evaluates largest-component physical radio rather than necessarily base-rooted communication. Do not transfer convergence claims or replace its metric.
options.do_not_redo: No CBBA port or planner expansion is justified for the current arrival-order toy fix.

recommended_now: Finish the parent's smallest lifecycle-order intervention, retain existing models and masks, validate fixed full-H300 joint completion and whole-window safety, then freeze any demonstrated improvement before considering further learning.
